title: The webinar
hook: You did your [bleep]ing webinar, right? Two hours. Twelve people stayed.
biais: interruption du schéma (une mascotte mignonne qui insulte)
caption:
Webinar done, replay sent, and now your DMs are full of "price?" and people who ghost after you answer.
Meet Setty, the AI setter I built for coaches who sell in the DMs. He learns your offer, talks like you, only sends your calendar to the serious ones and books the call.
Comment SETTY and he'll slide into your DMs.
